en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 1. My father (rah) from Muhammad b. Yahya from Muhammad b. Ahmad from Muhammad b. Hassaan from Ismail b. Mihran from al-Hassan from Sayf b. ’Umayra from Abi Bakr al-Hadhrami from Abi Ja’far (a.s.) who said:

"Whoever recites Surah Bayyinah, is untouched by Polytheism and has entered the religion of Muhammad (s.a.w.s.), and on the Day of Judgment, Allah would raise him as a believer, and his accounting would be very easy."
